comment: A stepped block for Extrude of a body face up to another face of the same body (mitcad#2033, tools/ui-extrude-face-to-object-test.sh): a 60 x 40 x 20 block (Sketch1 F1, Extrude1 F2, F2.b0) with a step on its right half, x = 30..60, joined 30 high from the sketch plane (Sketch2 F3, Extrude2 F4). The lower step's top F2:end(r{...}) lies at z = 20, the higher step's top F4:end(r{...}) at z = 30: 60000 mm3.
